__doc: Names a German delimitation prints that no layer carries under that name, bound to the units they name (scripts/_lib/de/area_units.py). Keyed by the record's file number, then by the unit as the resolver labels it. `units`: Gemarkungen as {land, schluessel} of raw/de/katasterbezirke/<land>.gpkg, or a GISCO commune as {gemeinde}. A pin whose Gemarkung the layer no longer carries is reported stale and draws nothing.

Stedten.reason: The single document files Stedten under «im Landkreis Saalekreis». Sachsen-Anhalt's land register has no Gemarkung Stedten in the Saalekreis; its one Gemarkung of the name in the five Kreise the text names is 152129, in the Gemeinde Seegebiet Mansfelder Land (Landkreis Mansfeld-Südharz) — the lake villages the same text lists under Mansfeld-Südharz (Seeburg, Lüttchendorf, Unterrißdorf).
Stedten.source: LVermGeo Sachsen-Anhalt, ALKIS Gemarkungen (WFS Gemarkung_Flur_OpenData), read 2026-11-24

Kromsdorf.reason: «Kromsdorf … im Landkreis Weimarer Land» is the former Gemeinde; the land register keeps its two Gemarkungen, Großkromsdorf and Kleinkromsdorf (Gemeinde Ilmtal-Weinstraße), and none called Kromsdorf.
Kromsdorf.source: TLBG Thüringen, ALKIS Gemarkungen (WFS adv_alkis_wfs), read 2026-11-24

Dorndorf-Steudnitz.reason: «Dorndorf-Steudnitz … im Landkreis Saale-Holzland-Kreis» is the former Gemeinde; the land register keeps its two Gemarkungen, Dorndorf and Steudnitz (Gemeinde Dornburg-Camburg).
Dorndorf-Steudnitz.source: TLBG Thüringen, ALKIS Gemarkungen (WFS adv_alkis_wfs), read 2026-11-24

Oberperl (3560).reason: «der Gemeinde/Ortsteile Perl (3570), Oberperl (3560), Perl/Nennig (3540), Perl/Sehndorf (3580)»: Oberperl is a Gemarkung of the Gemeinde Perl, as the three beside it are. No open Saarland Gemarkung layer is read, so the Gemeinde is drawn whole for the four.
Oberperl (3560).source: the single document's own sentence; GISCO LAU 2024 (Perl, DE_10042115)

Breitscheid (0261).reason: «Breitscheid (Landkreis Mainz-Bingen) (0261)»: the name and its Kreis are Gemarkung 3501 (Gemeinde Breitscheid, Landkreis Mainz-Bingen, beside Steeg 3502 and Bacharach 3503, which the same list prints); 0261 is the Gemarkung Breitscheid of the Landkreis Neuwied, on the Westerwald. The Kreis the text itself gives decides; the number is read as a slip.
Breitscheid (0261).source: LVermGeo Rheinland-Pfalz, Gemarkungen (vermkv:gemarkungen_rlp: gmkgnr 73501 and 70261), read 2026-11-24
